I run a landscaping crew in Vancouver. For years the office work got done at the kitchen table after dark.

Ittai is the AI office I built to do it instead. Six specialists and a chief of staff. Kaname keeps the day in order. Penny does the books, Mia the marketing, Sam the quotes. Otto the routes, Yui the inbox, Ada the systems.

Each of them proposes. I approve. Nothing goes out on its own.

It is built for any small field business, not only mine. More at ittai.ca soon.

Message me if you want to see it done on one of your own receipts.

Penny codes the receipts. I check them.

In October, [FIGURE] of her entries went through unchanged. The rest I corrected, and she learned the rule so the next one is right.

That is the whole arrangement. She proposes, I approve, and the books are mine to sign.

A client asked what the shrub by the gate was.

The crew took a photo. Ittai named it and wrote the care for that site for November: water, prune, feed. The card now sits on the job, so whoever visits next knows what it needs.

Gardening is my trade. Yours gets its own version.

#gardening #plantcare #fieldservice
What is this plant? Ittai knows, and what it needs this month.

Where is the crew?

Otto plans the route the night before, and the crew's phones report where they are during the day. I can see the day without ringing anyone, and a client who asks gets a straight answer.

The crew sees nothing new. The office stops guessing.

Before and after, [SITE OR JOB], [DAY].

The crew took both on the phone. One tap sent them to the client and to this page. Same photos, same day, no editing.

#beforeandafter #landscaping #Vancouver

I am taking on a handful before Ittai opens. You run a small field business, you want the office work off your evenings, and you will tell me plainly what is wrong.
